summary: Players run an art gallery, moving a single meeple around a Lisbon-style board to hire assistants, acquire and promote artists, host exhibitions, and sell paintings for profit and reputation. It's a dense, cerebral engine-builder with tight worker/time management and satisfying multi-step combos, marked by Lacerda's signature complexity and thematic depth.
praised: rich, thematic engine with a real sense of running a business
clever action-selection and movement system (single meeple, action cards)
gorgeous, thoughtful production and iconography once learned
criticised: very steep learning curve and rulebook density
long playtime and heavy analysis paralysis
can feel isolating/solitaire-ish with limited direct interaction

interaction.kind: competition for shared spaces/artists, mostly indirect

scoring.why: final wealth from art sales, reputation bonuses, and efficient use of contracts/loans determines the winner
